articles.title: Military aircraft to be equipped to fight wildfires
articles.summary: Military aircraft will be equipped to help tackle wildfires, the UK government has announced, after a summer of "unrelenting" blazes and sustained hot conditions.

articles.title: The national resilience moment that almost barely happened
articles.summary: It was the national resilience moment that very nearly barely happened.

articles.title: Woman, 27, charged after police officer shot in Nottingham city centre
articles.summary: A woman has been charged in connection with the shooting of a police officer in Nottingham city centre on Sunday, police have said.

articles.title: Winter energy supply secure but possible 'tight days' for electricity - grid operators
articles.summary: Britain's energy supplies are secure for winter, national grid operators have said, despite expected higher gas demand at peak times and possible "tight days" for electricity.

articles.title: Man charged with murder after woman found dead in car with puncture wounds
articles.summary: A man has been charged with murder after a housing association worker died following a car crash in South Wales, having sustained "puncture wounds".

articles.title: Sir Keir Starmer could be summoned to give evidence to grooming gangs inquiry
articles.summary: Sir Keir Starmer may be required to give evidence at the grooming gangs inquiry, with hearings due to begin in December.

articles.title: Could this be Labour's 'green argument' for approving controversial Rosebank oil field?
articles.summary: Former Labour deputy leader Harriet Harman has said she thinks ministers will approve drilling in the controversial Rosebank oil field - and that they will argue they will spend the proceeds investing in renewable energy.

articles.title: Amber weather warning in place as named storm hits UK - with another hours away
articles.summary: Several weather warnings are in place as the first named storm of the season is set to hit the UK today.

articles.title: PC Sharon Beshenivsky killer jailed over underworld guns operation
articles.summary: A getaway driver for the gang who shot dead PC Sharon Beshenivsky in an armed robbery has been given a life sentence with a minimum term of eight years over his role in an underworld gun business.
